about

I’m blackhawk0x — a CTF player. I spend most of my time pulling things apart: malware samples, binaries, and the occasional web app that really shouldn’t have shipped like that.

This site is where I write up CTF challenges, reverse-engineering notes, and malware analysis walkthroughs.

Currently interested in: reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat intel, Linux internals, and low-level exploitation.

Find me elsewhere via the links in the footer.
